# The Other Data

> theotherdata.com explains "alternative data": free public data sets (Federal Reserve series, government safety reports, river levels, filings) that may say something about well-known stocks. Every clue is shown in plain English with an honest, out-of-sample track record. Education only, not financial advice; the site never says what to buy or sell.

## Main pages
- [Home: stocks and their hidden signals](https://theotherdata.com/): search ~14,000 US stocks; 35 curated stocks get deep signals.
- [Track record](https://theotherdata.com/track): every lean checked against what the stock did next, vs the S&P 500, plus the tougher per-stock tests and what failed.
- Test status: every signal is labeled "Tested: no predictive power found" (backtested, no edge beyond chance) or "Not tested yet" (no dated history), from https://theotherdata.com/data/signal-status.json. The only result marked Passed is late-filing notices at 3 months, on /track. The site describes what the data did; it does not say which way a stock leans.
- [Do alt-data signals actually work?](https://theotherdata.com/alt-data-signals-work): plain-English summary of every test, what failed, the one passed result (late filings at 3 months), and the pass rules.
- [Scoreboard](https://theotherdata.com/scoreboard): each signal's hit rate with 95% ranges.
- [Recent late filers](https://theotherdata.com/late-filers): daily list of SEC Form 12b-25 late-filing notices (NT 10-K / NT 10-Q) filings and EDGAR links only.
- [How a signal is found](https://theotherdata.com/signal-walkthrough): one signal walked end to end.
- [How it works](https://theotherdata.com/how) and [How to read the site](https://theotherdata.com/how-to-read).
- [How I built this](https://theotherdata.com/how-i-built-this).

## Data files (JSON)
